scope: This closes the first-moment character-sum side of fixed-curve coverage. The separate Semaev nondegeneracy and total-energy estimate, its collector binding, and the end-to-end ECDLP runtime theorem remain open.
statement: For every nonsingular short Weierstrass curve over an odd finite field, every positive finite set of nonzero abscissas, and every radius satisfying the stated square and density inequalities, the concrete signed factor-base fibre count has mean at least three quarters of the abscissa count and at least one sixth of nonzero dilations have at least half that count.
